template_data.lead_html:
Her WOSB certification wasn't broken.
Her follow-up was.

rows.what_html: Certification arrives — she waits for the government to come calling
Still waiting — no capability statement sent, no CO outreach, no bids submitted
Calls me — "my certification isn't working." It is. You aren't.

template_data.closer: THE CERT OPENS THE DOOR. YOU STILL HAVE TO KNOCK.
